capabilities: Export the current note as a single Markdown file with images inlined as base64 data URIs
Preserve wiki embeds, alt text, titles and image widths in the exported file
Optionally download and inline remote images via requestUrl
Write the export to a vault folder or download it through the browser
Copy the inlined result to the clipboard without saving a file
disambiguation: Not a general Base64 encoder; it only inlines images as data URIs while exporting a note.
extras: The README is written entirely in Chinese. The plugin compares itself only against common implementation approaches, not against any named plugin. Known limits: base64 inflates file size by about 33%, in-vault exports overwrite same-name *.base64.md files, and some editors handle SVG data URIs poorly.
problem: Sharing a note that references local images breaks the image links, because the recipient does not have the vault's image files.
summary: Exports the current note as a self-contained Markdown file with images inlined as base64 data URIs, leaving the original note untouched.
